Scene 02

FBI HEADQUARTERS

Fox Mulder

I don't know, Scully. The man's vanished. He hasn't been seen or heard from in ten weeks.

Dana Scully

Don't you see what they're doing here? They're wasting our time. They're sending us on a wild-goose chase.

Fox Mulder

Chicken chase.

Dana Scully

What?

Fox Mulder

George Kearns was a federal poultry inspector... Assigned to Dudley, arkansas, home of Chaco chicken.

Dana Scully

I'm not questioning the legitimacy of the case, just their motives in assigning it to us. Doesn't it bother you that they're trying to undermine your work?

Fox Mulder

They may think they are, but on the night george Kearns disappeared, a woman on the I-10 saw a strange fire in an adjacent field.

Dana Scully

Yes, I read that report. She claims she saw some kind of Fox fire spirit. I'm surprised she didn't call oprah as soon as she got off the phone with the police.

Fox Mulder

Folk tales dating back to the 19th century from the ozarks... Describe people being taken away by fireballs. It's supposed to be the spirits of massacred indians.

Dana Scully

Those are only legends.

Fox Mulder

Most legends don't leave behind 12 foot burn marks. That photo was taken by police where the woman claims to have seen Fox fire.

Dana Scully

This could've been made by anything. A bonfire.

Fox Mulder

I thought so too, until I remembered this. A documentary I saw in college about an insane asylum. It gave me nightmares.

Dana Scully

I didn't think anything gave you nightmares.

Fox Mulder

I was young.

Jones

They, uh, they took-- they, uh, took me away. Th-they took me away. The fire demons. The fire demons wanted their pound of flesh. But, uh, I'm too fast for 'em.

[ nervous laughter ]

Jones

You can't let 'em kill you. You can't let 'em kill you. Oh, no. Don't let them kill you. That's no way to get to heaven. No, sir. No, sir, that is-- that is no way to get to heaven.

Fox Mulder

His name was crayton jones. He pulled off the road on may 17, 1961 to take a nap. They found him three days later so deranged by what he'd encountered... That he had to be committed. The police found his car on the I-10, in the middle of Dudley, arkansas, home of Chaco chicken.

Scene 03

DUDLEY, ARKANSAS

Dana Scully

What's this, Mulder?

Fox Mulder

That's a witch's peg. Staking it into the ground is supposed to ward off evil spirits.

Sheriff Arens

Can I help you folks? I'm sheriff Arens. I saw you back at the turnoff.

Fox Mulder

We're with the FBI I'm special agent Mulder, this is agent Scully. We're investigating the disappearance of george Kearns.

Sheriff Arens

I'm happy to help you, but I'm not sure how much there is to investigate.

Dana Scully

A man is missing.

Sheriff Arens

We didn't find evidence of criminal activity. Since no body turned up, we went ahead and filed a missing persons' report.

Fox Mulder

Why didn't you mention this witch's peg in your report?

Sheriff Arens

Because these hills are filled with witch's pegs. The old hill people cling tight to their superstitions.

Fox Mulder

What about this scorched area?

Sheriff Arens

Illegal trash burn. I keep handing out the citations, they keep doing it anyway. It's cheaper to pay the fine than haul it to the dump.

Fox Mulder

So you don't believe it's Fox fire?

Sheriff Arens

Fox fire's nothing more than a ghost story about swamp gas. I don't know what y'all thinking, but george Kearns was passing through town ever since he got here six months ago.

Dana Scully

How do you mean?

Sheriff Arens

Never did fit in. Not at the plant, not even in his own home. No big secret that Kearns stepped out on his wife every chance he got.

Dana Scully

Did he have many chances?

Sheriff Arens

Let's just say george is the type of man you'd expect... To go chasing some sweet young thing out of town.

Dana Scully

Is that what his wife thinks?

Sheriff Arens

Push comes to shove, I'm sure she does. But you're welcome to ask her yourself.

Scene 07

CHACO RESIDENCE

Fox Mulder

Mr. Chaco?

Chaco

Feeding these chickens... Helps me clear my mind. They're perfect creatures, you know. We eat their meat, their eggs, sleep on pillows stuffed with their feathers. Not many people I know are as useful as these chickens.

Dana Scully

We're sorry to disturb you. We realize this is a difficult time for you.

Chaco

You want to conduct an autopsy on my granddaughter. Why? You think paula had some kind of disease that made her act that way?

Dana Scully

That's what we're hoping a postmortem will determine.

Chaco

Thought your business here was george Kearns's disappearance.

Fox Mulder

It is, but we suspect that might have something to do with what happened to your granddaughter.

Chaco

How?

Fox Mulder

We're not sure yet. It's possible they may have both suffered from the same neurological disorder.

Chaco

When I came here after the war, Dudley was just a patch of dirt. I built that plant, and put my whole family to work there. We made this town one of the biggest chicken processors in the nation. We couldn't have done that with troublemakers and layabouts.

Dana Scully

I assume you're talking about george Kearns.

Chaco

Men like george Kearns don't build things. They tend to tear 'em down.

Dana Scully

Then you're aware of his recommendation to close down your plant.

Chaco

You know, [ sighs ] living a long life is a mixed blessin'. You spend your youth trying to build something for yourself, and your family, and your community, only to watch it all taken away from you at your old age. Still, I'm not ready to die just yet. You go do your autopsy on paula. I want to know what happened to my granddaughter.

Scene 08

SETH COUNT MORGUE

Dana Scully

I think we've got something here, Mulder. Take a look at this.

Fox Mulder

What am I looking at?

Dana Scully

It's a specimen from paula gray's brain. She suffered from a rare degenerative disorder called Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. It's characterized by sponge-like holes in the brain tissue.

Fox Mulder

Why didn't they show up on any of her charts?

Dana Scully

Short of an autopsy, it's a very difficult disease to diagnose. Outside of a textbook, I've only seen infected tissue once. Back in medical school.

Fox Mulder

Could this be the reason she attacked Jess howe?

Dana Scully

Absolutely. Victims of Creutzfeldt-Jakob suffer from... Progressive dementia, severe seizures.

Fox Mulder

Is it fatal?

Dana Scully

This girl would've been dead in a matter of months.

Fox Mulder

Except that paula gray was no girl. This is her personnel file. Check it out. It says here paula gray was born in 1948. Which means that this woman, Chaco's granddaughter, was 47 years old.

Dana Scully

There's gotta be some kind of mistake.

Fox Mulder

Let's find out. Her birth certificate should be on file at the seth county courthouse. Who knows? This could turn out to be even more interesting than Fox fire.

Fox Mulder

Scene 20

Scene 20

Dana Scully

Pending further review, the Chaco processing plant has been closed by the u.s.d.a. So far, no evidence of contaminated chicken has been discovered. Though it remains unknown how many citizens participated in the ritual activity, 27 have become fatally ill with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. What is known is that a transport plane carrying walter Chaco... Was shot down in 1944 over new guinea. Chaco was the only survivor of that crash. According to naval records, he spent six months with the jale, a tribe whose cannibalistic practices have long been suspected, but never proven. Naval records also show that walter Chaco was born in 1902, making him 93 years old at the time of his death. As of this date, his remains have yet to be found.
